name: @vssaros/dsh-scheduler
description: VsSaros Scheduler module for DeepSeek Harness: thin wrapper over the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule service (refactor 2.1 pilot). ActivityBar icon + schedule list page at /x/scheduler/ (list/delete via ctx.schedule), plus programmatic migration of legacy agentScheduler definitions (agent.yaml `schedules` entries — never executed by legacy, so migration is zero-regression). Legacy bridgeScheduler (IM channel timers) is NOT migrated here; it belongs to the channels family (2.4).
